_about: Enemy death sound prompts. 'enemies' has one per enemy kind (card.data.enemyType) and is what the game plays; 'families' are the older shared sounds, kept as the fallback for a kind with no sound of its own. generate-death-sounds.mjs sends prompts to ElevenLabs Sound Effects and saves takes to assets/_sfx_takes/ to audition; the chosen take is copied to assets/music/Death_<name>.mp3. Edit a prompt and re-run with --enemy <kind> --force to re-roll it. 'armor' holds the equip sounds per armor type (--set armor), copied to assets/music/Armor_<Type>.mp3. 'pickups' holds pick-up sounds (--set pickups). 'reverb' is the room reverb mixed into each set's takes (0 = dry). 'tone' is an ffmpeg filter applied to a set before its reverb. Each take's untouched original is kept as *.raw.mp3; --reprocess redoes tone/reverb/loudness from it without spending credits. 'combat' holds block and Bone Wall sounds (--set combat). 'events' holds one-off combat moments: Armor Broken, ENRAGED, Mimic Escaped (--set events).
style: realistic grounded foley for a dark fantasy game, layered and weighty with a full low end, short natural room reverb, serious and organic, not cartoonish, not retro, no music, no speech
